When all forty components update at once they fight over the phone's processor and memory, and Corvane's own profiling shows each one runs about four times slower than it does alone. The map took about 0.3 seconds by itself in the standard tests, so with everything running it would need around 1.2 seconds, and the screen isn't done until the map is. That's more than twice the limit even though every piece passed separately. This is the classic gap between unit tests and integration tests, which is why a lot of app teams also time the whole screen end to end before a release.
